utaustin.tuition_note: Tuition and mandatory fees. UT publishes a range of $10,858-$13,576 for Texas residents depending on college; this page starts from the low end and adds the published McCombs, Cockrell and Natural Sciences differentials. Resident undergraduate tuition is frozen for 2025-26 and 2026-27. Programs not listed here may cost more, so check UT's tuition chart.
utaustin.nonres_note: The Texas Advance Commitment is for Texas residents, so this estimate assumes no need-based aid. Merit scholarships are possible but rare.
utaustin.major_aid_text: {college} may offer its own college- and department-level scholarships on top of university aid. Search UT's Scholarship Finder by college and major. Tuition is the part of your cost that changes with your major: McCombs and Cockrell add about $1,100 a year for residents, and Natural Sciences about $500.

aid_options.name: Texas Advance Commitment
aid_options.what: Tuition is covered for family income up to $100,000 (after Pell and Texas Grant). Families between $100,001 and $125,000 get partial tuition help. No separate application beyond the FAFSA or TASFA.

aid_options.name: Pell Grant and Texas Grant
aid_options.what: Federal and state grants are applied first. UT fills any remaining tuition gap for Texas Advance Commitment students.

aid_options.name: Forty Acres Scholars Program
aid_options.what: UT's flagship full-ride-plus-enrichment scholarship, given to only about 15-25 incoming freshmen a year. Don't count on it.

aid_options.name: College and department scholarships
aid_options.what: Colleges like McCombs, Cockrell, Moody and Liberal Arts run their own awards. Filter by college and major in UT's Scholarship Finder.

aid_options.name: Federal Work-Study
aid_options.what: Part-time campus jobs for students with financial need.

aid_options.name: Tuition rebate
aid_options.what: Eligible graduates can get up to $1,000 back, plus $2,500 more if they chose Longhorn Fixed Tuition.

aid_options.name: If you're from out of state
aid_options.what: Need-based programs like the Texas Advance Commitment are for Texas residents. Non-residents can still compete for merit awards, and a competitive scholarship of at least $1,000 may qualify you for in-state tuition. Ask UT's financial aid office.

area.label: West Campus bed in a shared unit

utaustin.area_note: Rent near campus can use most of UT's housing-and-food budget, so living in West Campus may cost more than the estimate. Rent figures come from fall 2026 listings and vary by source and lease.

dartmouth.tuition_note: Tuition is $71,697 plus $2,157 in fees (financial aid office figures). Dartmouth's admissions page lists a slightly higher total ($98,946), so confirm with the school. Health insurance ($5,216) is not included; students on need-based aid get at least half of it back as extra scholarship. Dartmouth runs on three terms per year.
dartmouth.major_aid_text: At Dartmouth, tuition and need-based aid are the same for every major, so choosing a major doesn't change these estimates. Dartmouth offers only need-based aid (no merit or athletic scholarships).

aid_options.name: Need-based Dartmouth Scholarship
aid_options.what: Dartmouth meets 100% of demonstrated need with scholarships and student work. Aid packages never include a required loan.

aid_options.name: Zero parent contribution
aid_options.what: Families with income under $125,000 and typical assets are not expected to contribute. Students still contribute from work and savings.

aid_options.name: Free tuition
aid_options.what: Families earning under $175,000 with typical assets can expect a scholarship covering at least full tuition. There is no income cutoff for aid consideration.

aid_options.name: QuestBridge National College Match
aid_options.what: Match students have $0 parent contribution and $0 loans for all four years.

aid_options.name: Student contribution
aid_options.what: Plan on roughly $1,000-$2,500 a year from leave-term earnings, plus any summer work or savings.

aid_options.name: No merit or athletic scholarships
aid_options.what: Dartmouth offers only need-based aid. Outside scholarships you win can reduce the work or savings part of your package.

area.label: Room in a shared student house

dartmouth.area_note: Most students live in college housing, so the school's budget is the best guide. Off-campus rent figures come from 2025-26 sources and may be dated. Travel costs aren't itemized in Dartmouth's budget, so add flights or gas if you live far away.
